status: experimental; implementation syntax-checked, GPU smoke pending
hypothesis: Continuing the final two Parakeet encoder layers on joint future voice activity improves downstream turn-event prediction beyond a frozen encoder
train_only: Exactly 16 conversations from the pinned speaker-separated Otospeech training partition, validated before waveform or annotation access
objective: 256-class joint VAP; two channels times four consecutive bins, 0.2/0.4/0.6/0.8 seconds; at least 50 percent annotated occupancy sets each bit
targets: Future annotation only. Actual 160ms audio-availability grid. Complete two-second target horizon required. No future target audio is loaded.
input_crop: 6.4 seconds warmup plus 10.24 seconds scored; channel swap augmentation
optimizer: AdamW, encoder1e-5/head3e-4, weight_decay0.01, clipping1; final2 encoder layers and1024-256-256 MLP
training: 4 independent conversations,64 scored chunks accumulated per update,100 updates maximum; entire encoder stays eval; cuDNN TF32 disabled
tbptt: Detach all caches after every chunk. Do not run this through inference-mode encoder.extract: direct differentiable cache_aware_stream_step is required.
checkpoint: Atomic replacement every25 updates, including encoder/head/optimizer/Python/NumPy/Torch/CUDA RNG and provenance; resume requires identical recipe, audit, model revision and code hash
selection: This script performs no development selection or benchmark evaluation. Parent compares dev VAP and identical downstream heads against frozen baseline. VAP improvement alone is not turn-performance evidence.
limitations: Synthetic gradient, checkpoint and post-update causality smoke pending. Actual training throughput/memory unknown. Crop resets limit long-context distribution. Labels are single-annotator Otospeech speech intervals, not benchmark consensus or Ooma's undisclosed exact recipe.
